About.headline: A UK-China bridge for global buyers.
About.intro: Albion Exports is a British-owned trading company registered in China. We exist to take the risk out of sourcing from Chinese manufacturers — verifying suppliers in person, handling export, and delivering to buyers across the UK, Europe and beyond.

story.title: Why we exist
story.body: Buyers want China's price and scale without the risk of unverified suppliers, miscommunication, or shipments that don't match the brief. Albion was founded by a British national resident in Hefei, China — bridging both sides of that conversation. We carry the procurement, verification and export load so our buyers don't have to.

Services.headline: Consumer goods across categories — verified at source.
Services.intro: We work across our full licensed scope, generalised as consumer goods. Below is what buyers most often ask us for. If your category isn't listed, ask — most of what's tradeable in China sits within our scope.

pet.title: Pet food & supplies
pet.body: Pet food, treats, toys, accessories, beds, leashes, feeders. Both premium and everyday SKUs. We work with manufacturers carrying export certifications for the UK and EU pet markets.
pet.examples: Examples: dry food, wet food, treats, chew toys, leashes, harnesses, beds, feeders, water fountains.

sports.title: Sports & outdoor
sports.body: Sports apparel, fitness equipment, outdoor gear, accessories. Suitable for retail, gym distribution, or branded white-label.
sports.examples: Examples: yoga mats, resistance bands, dumbbells, gym apparel, outdoor jackets, camping gear, water bottles, sports bags.

household.title: Household & daily goods
household.body: Kitchenware, cleaning, organisation, daily consumables. Volume categories with strong manufacturer choice across China.
household.examples: Examples: kitchenware sets, cleaning supplies, storage and organisation, towels, bedding basics, daily disposables.

furniture.title: Furniture parts & fittings
furniture.body: Components, hardware, fittings, finishings. Both finished products and parts for buyers manufacturing or assembling locally.
furniture.examples: Examples: hinges, drawer slides, handles, knobs, brackets, glass tops, fabric panels, finished modular pieces.

electronics.title: Consumer electronics
electronics.body: Smart in-vehicle equipment, small consumer electronics, accessories. We handle the certification side (CE, UKCA, FCC) up front so buyers don't have to.
electronics.examples: Examples: dashcams, car chargers, phone accessories, audio accessories, wearable accessories, small smart-home devices.

adjacent.title: Adjacent categories
adjacent.body: Stationery, luggage, gifting, security and protection equipment, arts and crafts. If you're sourcing something consumer-facing, ask.
adjacent.examples: Examples: stationery sets, luggage, backpacks, branded gifting, security devices, decorative items.

items.food: Human food products requiring refrigerated import chains.
items.pharma: Pharmaceuticals or anything requiring medical-device approval.
items.ivory: Ivory products (excluded by licence and policy).
